snippet.title: GRAVELORD - Level Editor - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823990/Gravelord/

Fatbot Games is excited to announce the public launch of the GRAVELORD LEVEL EDITOR! The tool is included in the GRAVELORD early access version available on the Steam platform. Originally introduced through a limited playtest, the editor is now open to everyone and enables players and creators to build custom levels for Gravelord using a simplified, TrenchBroom-inspired workflow designed for fast, creative, block-based mapmaking.
